# ScalableNeuromorphicTopology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network-level design principle where spiking neurons and synapses are arranged in reconfigurable, hierarchical or mesh-like topologies that can expand without global coordination. Bridges TCC and iNEST by showing how topology-centric routing and local connectivity enable scaling of neuromorphic chips beyond fixed-size arrays.
